subject: ghost-haven
label: Beam by beam, and orgasm by orgasm
from: The family built it, with excavation, plumbing and central air contracted out — and the Archive left the contractor list open-ended
to: EXACTLY THREE OUTSIDE TRADES EVER SET FOOT HERE. Everything else is the girls' own hands
note:
THE TIMELINE FIRST. RAGNAR GAVE BRYN THE LAND IN ARC 2. CONSTRUCTION STARTED PROPERLY IN ARC 4 — the arc whose entire content is the house going up and being christened.

AND THE LABOUR LIST IS CLOSED. Three trades came in from outside and no others: PLUMBING, EXCAVATION, CENTRAL AIR. Ragnar produced all three and asked nothing. The Archive had been writing 'contractors' as an open category, and half the ones it was implying never existed.

EVERY OTHER BEAM IN THIS BUILDING WAS SET BY A WOMAN WHO LIVES IN IT. Abbi forged the hinges, handles and hooks. Bryn framed. Livi hauled. They put up a thirty-two-bedroom compound with their own arms across one arc — and they did it BEAM BY BEAM AND ORGASM BY ORGASM, because a construction site staffed entirely by this family was never going to be a construction site only.

THE GARAGE STAIN IS THE PHYSICAL EVIDENCE OF THAT SECOND HALF, and Viraena named it as the direct consequence.
